key_insight: This paper addresses how to assess fatigue damage in aluminium-to-steel welded joints under multiaxial loading, a critical challenge for mixed-material structural connections.
engineering_relevance: Its findings are relevant for designing more reliable lightweight hybrid joints in transport and infrastructure where cyclic loading and dissimilar metals intersect.
method: Journal-article study focused on multiaxial fatigue assessment of aluminium-to-steel welded joints.
Uses fracture/fatigue evaluation methods appropriate for welded dissimilar-material connections.
Positions the problem within welding-process and structural integrity analysis.
evidence_signal: The abstract indicates bibliographic indexing rather than experimental details, so the available evidence signal is a journal article record in OpenAlex/White Rose Research Online.
watch_item: Because the abstract does not report specimens, loading conditions, or quantitative results, implementation guidance should be treated as preliminary until the full paper is reviewed.
paper_title: Multiaxial fatigue assessment of aluminium-to-steel welded joints
